title: 第8章酒肆盟誓四侠初结第9章宦党设阱步步吞杀
content_zh:
第8章酒肆盟誓，四侠初结
大魏天启十八年，晚秋，秋深霜重。帝都天牢深藏皇城西北角，高墙叠丈，铁网横空，终年不见日光，唯有腥风与寒雾终日盘旋。此处关押的皆是江湖重犯、朝堂钦囚，守卫森严堪比皇城禁地，十二道精铁牢门层层锁闭，禁军狱卒轮班值守，弓弩手隐于高墙垛口，昼夜无休。寻常人但凡靠近百丈之内，便会被即刻拿下，是帝都人人闻之色变的绝地。而这一日，沉寂多年的天牢地底，却藏着一场无人知晓的惊天营救，即将搅动整个江湖的风云。
三更梆子声堪堪落下，皇城夜色浓如墨汁，乌云蔽月，星子全无。天牢外围的禁军巡队踏着整齐的步伐缓缓走过，铁甲碰撞之声清脆冰冷，回荡在空旷的街巷之中。待巡队走远，一道纤细如鬼魅的黑影贴着高墙阴影，身形飘忽，落地无声，宛若夜间灵猫，悄然滑至天牢最偏僻的西北角暗渠入口。此人正是包不同，江湖无人知晓其师承来历，只知他身法诡秘无双，擅长潜行匿踪、开锁破阵，一身轻功臻至踏雪无痕、穿墙隐影的化境，更精通各类机关秘术，是江湖中最为神秘的独行客。
天牢暗渠乃是早年建狱时预留的排水通道，入口常年被精铁栅门封死，栅门锁芯镶嵌特制机关，寻常江湖高手穷尽数年也无法破解，且渠中布满毒瘴与细铁丝网，稍有不慎，便会触发机关，落得身殒渠中的下场。但包不同神色淡然，指尖夹着一枚薄如蝉翼的乌铁细片，手腕轻抖，细片探入锁芯，只听极细微的“咔嗒”一声轻响，紧锁数年的铁栅应声而开，全程无声无息，未惊动半分守卫。
他侧身闪身入内，抬手拂去肩头沾染的夜露，身形融入幽暗渠洞之中。暗渠内潮湿阴冷，腐臭气息混杂着地牢独有的血腥气扑面而来，漆黑一片，伸手不见五指。渠壁布满青苔湿滑，脚下积水深浅难测，两侧壁间暗藏无数锋利倒刺，一旦触碰，便是穿筋透骨之祸。包不同早有预判，身形起落轻盈如羽，足尖精准点在凸起的石棱之上，避开所有机关陷阱，一路纵深，径直向天牢地底死囚牢而去。
此次他冒死闯狱，只为营救两人——身负血海深仇、被权贵构陷入狱的陈尽仇，以及因擅查朝堂秘案、触怒权臣而被打入天牢的女剑客苏无艳。二人皆是江湖风骨凛然之士，因不肯依附朝堂奸佞、不愿同流合污，被罗织莫须有的罪名，打入天牢待斩。朝堂权贵本欲借秋决之机，将二人悄无声息除掉，永绝后患，却未曾料到，半路杀出包不同这等隐世高手，不惜以身犯险，夜闯天牢。
地底死囚牢较之地面更为阴寒刺骨，石壁凝着寒霜，每一间囚牢都锁着绝望与死寂。铁链拖地的哗啦声、囚徒微弱的喘息声，在幽深的地牢中格外清晰。包不同屏息凝神，避开层层暗哨与巡狱狱卒，凭借对天牢机关布局的精准掌握，辗转穿梭于各条甬道之间。不多时，他便停在最深处两间相邻的囚牢之外。
左侧囚牢之内，陈尽仇背靠冰冷石壁而坐，一身青色布衣早已被血水与污渍浸透，多处伤口溃烂结痂，发丝凌乱黏在脸颊，面容憔悴却难掩眼底凌厉锋芒。他本是世家子弟，家族世代忠良，却因揭发当朝太尉贪赃枉法、勾结匪类的罪证，被太尉一党反咬一口，诬陷通敌叛国，满门抄斩，唯有他一人侥幸存活，却也惨遭擒拿，受尽酷刑。经年牢狱折磨、百般刑具加身，未曾磨去他半分傲骨，那双眸子依旧澄澈锐利，藏着焚尽一切的血海深仇，亦藏着坚守本心的赤诚。听见脚步声靠近，他未曾抬头，只低声冷道：“来者何人？是来催命，还是来折辱陈某？”
包不同低声回应，嗓音低沉沙哑，不带半分波澜：“我来带你出去。”
陈尽仇闻言缓缓抬眸，目光扫过眼前黑影，见对方身形挺拔、气息沉稳，周身无半分恶意，眼底闪过一丝诧异，随即化为沉沉漠然：“天牢固若金汤，层层重兵把守，无人可破。阁下不必白费力气，更不必因我这戴罪之人，枉送性命。”他早已看透朝堂险恶、世事凉薄，早已不奢望有人前来相救，只一心等着秋决之日，留得清白风骨，来世再报血海家仇。
包不同未曾多言辩解，指尖铁片再度微动，连续几声轻响，牢门厚重的精铁大锁应声崩开。沉重的牢门被轻轻推开，一股阴冷寒气扑面而来。他转身走向右侧囚牢，牢中之人正是苏无艳。
苏无艳一身素白劲装早已斑驳破损，手腕脚踝皆被粗重铁链锁缚，皮肉被铁链磨得红肿溃烂，却始终脊背挺直，未曾有半分佝偻。她出身江湖名门，一手流云剑法出神入化，性子刚烈果敢，嫉恶如仇。此番入狱，只因她偶然查获太尉私通江湖邪派、暗中培植死士的秘证，欲将真相公之于众，却被对方提前察觉，设下圈套擒获，打入天牢。狱中多日，酷刑百般，她从未吐露半句秘辛，更未曾低头求饶。此刻见牢门开启，她明眸微抬，清冷目光落在包不同身上，无惊无喜，唯有淡然戒备：“阁下何故救我？天下没有免费的恩情，还请直言所求。”
包不同素来寡言，行事只求本心，不图回报，只淡淡道：“看不惯奸佞当道，英雄蒙尘。无需回报，只需脱困之后，守本心，行正道，足矣。”
话音落时，他双手齐动，指尖真气灌注，精准扣住铁链锁芯，瞬息之间便震断锁住二人手脚的精铁锁链。锁链落地，发出清脆声响，在寂静地牢中格外突兀。三人不敢耽搁半分，知晓天牢机关联动，稍有动静便会触发警报，引来重兵围剿。陈尽仇与苏无艳强忍身上伤痛，收敛周身气息，紧随包不同身后，沿着来时的隐秘暗渠，飞速撤离。
行至暗渠中段，变故陡生。地面传来急促的脚步声与甲胄摩擦之声，狱卒似乎察觉异常，已然下地巡查。紧接着，无数箭矢从渠壁暗藏的暗孔中飞射而出，密密麻麻，箭势迅猛，封住所有去路。包不同身形骤然腾空，双掌翻飞，掌风凌厉如刀，卷起渠中积水与碎泥，凌空扫落漫天飞箭，动作行云流水，毫无滞涩。“快走！我断后！”他低喝一声，气息沉稳，稳稳挡住所有攻势。
陈尽仇虽身受重伤，一身功力未散，当即回身，双掌运力拍出，浑厚掌气激荡而出，将两侧逼近的毒箭尽数震碎。苏无艳亦不甘示弱，抬手抽出腰间暗藏的半截断剑，剑光凛冽，辗转腾挪之间，格挡开漏网的箭矢，二人一左一右，与包不同互为犄角。三人配合默契，无需言语，便已然达成默契，硬生生在漫天箭雨之中杀出一条生路。
待三人冲出暗渠，跃出天牢高墙之时，东方天际已然泛起一抹鱼肚白，长夜将尽，晨雾渐起，笼罩整座帝都。身后天牢之内，警钟大作，厮杀声、传令声、铁甲碰撞声混杂一片，禁军已然发现囚犯越狱，全城搜捕即刻开启。三人不敢在帝都停留片刻，趁着晨雾掩护，身形疾掠，一路奔出城外数十里，直至抵达城郊一处无人知晓的山野荒路，方才驻足停歇。
一路疾驰，伤口崩裂，鲜血浸透衣衫，陈尽仇与苏无艳皆是气息不稳，微微喘息。二人相视一眼，皆是从对方眼底看到了相似的风骨——皆为奸佞所害，皆守正道初心，皆身负未了恩怨。经此一场生死营救、并肩突围，陌生隔阂尽数消散，唯有患难与共的赤诚悄然滋生。
“此番脱困，大恩不言谢。”陈尽仇对着包不同拱手作揖，语气诚恳厚重，“陈某身负血海家仇，此生必诛奸邪，肃清朝堂污秽。他日但凡有用得着之处，刀山火海，在所不辞。”
苏无艳亦微微颔首，眸光清冷坚定：“我必继续追查太尉罪证，揭穿其狼子野心，还江湖清明，还世间公道。阁下救命之恩，苏某铭记于心，生死相报。”

包不同轻轻摆手，神色淡然：“举手之劳而已。如今太尉权倾朝野，爪牙遍布天下，你二人孤身一人，前路凶险重重，寸步难行。单凭一己之力，难撼根深蒂固的奸佞势力。”
三人正低语闲谈，商议后续去路，忽闻身后传来一阵沉稳脚步声。来人步伐不急不缓，落地厚重有力，带着常年习武之人的沉稳气场。众人回头望去，只见一名青衫壮汉缓步走来，身形魁梧挺拔，肩宽背阔，手掌宽厚粗糙，虎口布满厚茧，一眼便知是常年执器、深耕武行之人。此人正是铁寻柳。
铁寻柳本是天下第一铸剑师，一手铸剑绝技冠绝江湖，半生为天下侠客铸剑砺锋，铸出无数神兵利刃，素来不问朝堂纷争，隐居山野铸剑为业。奈何树大招风，太尉听闻其绝技，强行征召，命其为自己铸造绝世神兵，以供一己私欲，妄图持神兵震慑江湖、巩固权位。铁寻柳生性刚正，不屑为奸佞铸器，断然拒绝，因此触怒太尉，惨遭打压。官府捣毁其铸剑庐，屠戮其门下弟子，他侥幸脱身，却也被朝廷列为叛民，四处通缉，自此流落江湖，隐忍潜行。

Chapter 8: The oath of alliance in the wine shop, the first formation of the four heroes
In the eighteenth year of Tianqi's reign in the Great Wei Dynasty, it was late autumn and the autumn was deep and frosty. The imperial capital Tianlao is hidden deep in the northwest corner of the imperial city. It has high walls and iron nets. It does not see sunlight all year round, and only the fishy wind and cold fog hover all day long. The prisoners here are all serious criminals and prisoners of the imperial court. The guards are as tight as the forbidden areas of the imperial city. The twelve fine iron prison doors are locked layer by layer. The guards of the imperial army are on duty in shifts. The archers and crossbowmen are hidden in the crenellations of the high walls day and night. As long as ordinary people come within a hundred feet, they will be captured immediately. This is the point where everyone in the imperial capital changes their expressions upon hearing this. But on this day, there was a shocking rescue hidden in the underground prison that had been silent for many years, which no one knew about, and was about to stir up the storm in the entire world.
The sound of the clappers has faded at the third watch. The night in the imperial city is as thick as ink, dark clouds cover the moon, and there are no stars at all. The Imperial Guard patrol outside the Tianlao walked slowly and neatly, and the sound of the collision of armor was clear and cold, echoing in the empty streets. When the patrol walked away, a slender ghost-like black shadow clung to the shadow of the high wall. Its figure was erratic and fell to the ground silently. Like a civet at night, it quietly slid to the entrance of the culvert in the most remote northwest corner of Tianlao. This person is none other than Bao BuTong. No one in the world knows where he came from. They only know that his body skills are mysterious and unrivaled. He is good at sneaking, opening locks and breaking formations. He has such lightness that he can walk on snow without leaving a trace or walk through walls without being seen. He is also proficient in all kinds of secret techniques. He is the most mysterious lone traveler in the world.
The Tianlao culvert was a drainage channel reserved when the prison was built in the early years. The entrance was sealed all year round by a fine iron gate. The lock core of the gate was inlaid with a special mechanism that ordinary martial arts experts could not crack after spending years. Moreover, the canal was filled with poisonous miasma and fine barbed wire. If you were not careful, the mechanism would be triggered and you would end up dead in the canal. But Bao BuTong looked indifferent, holding a thin piece of black iron as thin as a cicada's wing between his fingertips. With a flick of his wrist, the thin piece penetrated the lock core. There was only a very subtle "click" sound, and the iron gate that had been locked for several years opened in response. The whole process was silent and did not alert the guards at all.
He ducked in sideways, raised his hand to brush off the night dew on his shoulders, and blended into the dark canal. The culvert was damp and cold, and the rancid smell mixed with the unique bloody smell of the dungeon came to the face. It was pitch black and it was impossible to see even one's fingers. The walls of the canal are covered with moss and slippery, and the depth of the water under your feet is unpredictable. There are countless sharp barbs hidden between the walls on both sides. Once touched, it will be a disaster that penetrates the muscles and bones. Bao BuTong had already predicted that, his body rose and fell as light as a feather, his toes accurately pointed on the raised stone edges, avoiding all traps, and went straight to the death row under the sky and underground prison.
This time he risked his life to break into prison just to rescue two people - Chen Jinqiu, who had a blood feud and was framed and imprisoned by the powerful, and the female swordsman Su Wuyan who was thrown into the sky prison for investigating secret cases in the court and offending powerful officials. Both of them are men of great character. Because they refused to be attached to the traitors in the court or join in the evil deeds, they were accused of unfounded crimes and sent to prison to be executed. The dignitaries in the court originally wanted to take advantage of the Autumn Battle to quietly get rid of the two men and avoid future troubles forever, but they never expected that hidden masters like Bao BuTong would show up halfway, risking their lives and breaking into the sky prison at night.
The underground death row is even colder and biting than the ground. The stone walls are covered with frost, and every cell is locked in despair and deathly silence. The sound of chains dragging the floor and the prisoners' faint breathing were particularly clear in the deep dungeon. Bao BuTong held his breath and concentrated, avoiding layers of secret sentries and patrolling jailers. He relied on his precise grasp of the layout of the prison to move through the various corridors. Not long after, he stopped outside the two adjacent cells in the deepest part.
On the left side of the prison cell, Chen Jinchou was sitting with his back against the cold stone wall. His blue cloth had already been soaked with blood and stains. Many wounds were ulcerated and scabbed. His hair was messy and stuck to his cheeks. His face was haggard but he could not hide the sharpness in his eyes. He was originally a son of an aristocratic family, and his family had been loyal for generations. However, because he exposed the evidence of corruption, perversion of the law, and collusion with bandits by the prince, he was bitten by the prince's party and falsely accused of treason and treason.The whole family was executed, but he was the only one who managed to survive, but he was also captured and tortured. Years of torture in prison and all kinds of instruments of torture have not worn away any of his pride. His eyes are still clear and sharp, hiding the blood-stained hatred that consumes everything and the sincerity to stick to his true heart. Hearing the footsteps approaching, he did not raise his head, but said coldly in a low voice: "Who is here? Are you here to urge me to die, or are you here to humiliate Chen?"
Bao BuTong responded in a low voice, his voice low and hoarse, without any ripples: "I'll take you out."
Chen Jinchou slowly raised his eyes after hearing the words, and glanced at the dark shadow in front of him. He saw that the other party had a tall and straight figure, a calm aura, and no malice in his body. A trace of surprise flashed in his eyes, and then turned into a heavy indifference: "The sky is as solid as gold, and it is heavily guarded by layers of troops. No one can break it. You don't have to waste your efforts, let alone lose your life because of me, a guilty person." He has already seen through the dangers of the court and the desolation of the world, and no longer expects anyone to come to rescue him. He only wants to wait for the day of autumn to keep his integrity and avenge the bloody family in the next life.
Bao BuTong didn't say much in defense. The iron piece at his fingertips moved slightly again, and with several soft sounds in succession, the heavy fine iron lock of the cell door collapsed. The heavy cell door was gently pushed open, and a cold air rushed in. He turned around and walked towards the prison on the right. The person in the prison was none other than Su Wuyan.
Su Wuyan's plain white outfit was already mottled and damaged, her wrists and ankles were bound by heavy iron chains, and her skin was red, swollen and ulcerated by the iron chains, but her back was always straight and not even a little rickety. She comes from a well-known family, has superb Liuyun sword skills, has a strong and courageous temperament, and hates evil as much as she hates it. This time she was imprisoned because she accidentally found out the secret evidence that the Taiwei was having an affair with evil sects and secretly cultivating dead men. She wanted to make the truth public, but she was discovered by the other party in advance, set up a trap, captured her, and was thrown into the sky prison. She was imprisoned for many days and tortured in various ways, but she never revealed a word of her secrets, nor did she bow her head to beg for mercy. Seeing the cell door open at this moment, she raised her bright eyes slightly, and her cold gaze fell on Bao BuTong. She was not surprised or happy, but was calmly on guard: "Why did you save me? There is no free kindness in the world, so please speak out what you want."
Bao BuTong has always been a man of few words. He only acts based on his heart and does not seek rewards. He only said lightly: "I can't stand the treacherous and sycophant in power, and the hero is covered in dust. There is no need to repay. As long as you get out of trouble, stick to your heart and follow the right path. That's enough."
When he finished speaking, he moved his hands together, filled his fingertips with true energy, and accurately grasped the iron chain lock core, breaking the fine iron chains that locked their hands and feet in an instant. The chain fell to the ground, making a crisp sound, which was particularly abrupt in the silent dungeon. The three of them did not dare to delay for even a moment, knowing that the sky prison was linked to each other. The slightest movement would trigger an alarm and attract heavy troops to encircle and suppress them. Chen Jinqiu and Su Wuyan endured the pain on their bodies, gathered their auras, followed Bao Tongtong, and quickly evacuated along the hidden culvert they came from.
When we reached the middle of the culvert, something unexpected happened suddenly. The sound of rapid footsteps and the friction of armor could be heard on the ground. The jailer seemed to have noticed something unusual and had already gone down to inspect the ground. Immediately afterwards, countless arrows flew out from the hidden holes in the canal wall. They were densely packed and the arrows were fast and fierce, blocking all paths. Bao BuTong's figure suddenly jumped into the air, his palms flying, the wind of his palms was as sharp as a knife, rolling up the water and mud in the canal, and sweeping down the flying arrows in the sky. His movements were smooth and smooth, without any hesitation. "Quickly go! I'll stop the queen!" He shouted lowly, his breath calm, and he steadily blocked all attacks.
Although Chen Jinchou was seriously injured, his skill was still intact. He immediately turned around and used his palms to strike out. The thick palm energy surged out and shattered all the poisonous arrows approaching from both sides. Not to be outdone, Su Wuyan raised her hand and drew out the half-severed sword hidden in her waist. The sword's light was sharp, and as she moved around, she blocked the arrows that slipped through the net. The two of them were on the left and the right, and they were horns with Bao Bu. The three of them cooperated in a tacit understanding, and without any words, they had already reached a tacit understanding, and they were able to fight their way out of the rain of arrows in the sky.
When the three of them rushed out of the culvert and jumped out of the high wall of the Tianlao, a fish belly appeared on the eastern horizon.It's white, the long night is coming to an end, and the morning fog is gradually rising, covering the entire imperial capital. In the sky prison behind him, alarm bells rang loudly, and the sounds of fighting, orders, and armor clashing were mixed together. The Imperial Army had discovered that the prisoner had escaped, and the city-wide manhunt was immediately launched. The three of them did not dare to stay in the imperial capital for a moment. They took advantage of the cover of the morning mist and rushed out of the city for dozens of miles. They did not stop until they reached an unknown mountain road on the outskirts of the city.
As they galloped all the way, their wounds burst open and their clothes were soaked with blood. Both Chen Jinchou and Su Wuyan were breathing unsteadily and panting slightly. The two of them looked at each other, and they both saw a similar character in each other's eyes - both were victims of traitors, both adhered to the right path, and both had unresolved grievances. After this life-and-death rescue and side-by-side breakout, all the strange barriers disappeared, and only the sincerity of sharing weal and woe quietly grew.
"I can't thank you enough for this great kindness." Chen Jinchou bowed his hands to Bao Tongtong and said in a sincere and sincere tone, "Chen has a bloody family feud. In this life, he will punish evildoers and clean up the filth in the court. In the future, wherever he can be useful, he will fight with swords and fire."
